import os, hmac, hashlib, base64, pathlib, sys

body_path = pathlib.Path('/inputs/body.json')
out_path = pathlib.Path('/work/hmac.txt')

print('body_exists', body_path.exists())
print('body_size', body_path.stat().st_size if body_path.exists() else None)

secret = os.environ.get('SHOPIFY_API_SECRET')
print('secret_present', secret is not None)
print('secret_len', len(secret) if secret is not None else None)

if secret is None:
    raise RuntimeError('SHOPIFY_API_SECRET is not set in environment')

body = body_path.read_bytes()
digest = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
value = base64.b64encode(digest).decode('ascii')

out_path.write_text(value + '\n', encoding='ascii')

# verify exact format: ASCII only, one trailing newline
raw = out_path.read_bytes()
try:
    raw.decode('ascii')
    ascii_ok = True
except UnicodeDecodeError:
    ascii_ok = False
print('wrote', out_path)
print('bytes_written', len(raw))
print('ascii_ok', ascii_ok)
print('endswith_newline', raw.endswith(b'\n'))
print('newline_count', raw.count(b'\n'))
